scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:ts: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern infra console && prettier --check infra console .github '*.{json,mjs}'
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && uv run mypy services agent tests seed scripts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run synth
scripts.format: prettier --write infra console .github '*.{json,mjs}' && uv run ruff format .
